findings.passage: I will not authorize, permit, or distribute any resources to support efforts to arm teachers. State law is clear that our schools are gun-free zones for teachers and students. The law allows exceptions for commissioned police officers on our school grounds, and for designated and trained school resource officers.
findings.note: OSPI statement responding to a reported federal plan to let grant money buy guns for teachers; he says he will not support arming teachers.

findings.passage: While no research indicates arming teachers improves student safety, an abundance of research clearly shows gun density is strongly correlated with higher rates of homicide and suicide.
findings.note: Same statement; cites research linking how many guns are around to homicide and suicide rates.

findings.passage: As a father, community member, and our state’s schools chief, I am making a personal appeal to you today to please reconsider gun possession in your home if you are a gun owner today
findings.note: Statement after the Texas school shooting, quoted by a news outlet (The Spokesman-Review); asks gun owners to reconsider keeping guns at home.

findings.passage: There is simply no debate: Our homes are safer when there are no guns inside them.
findings.note: Same statement as quoted by The Spokesman-Review.

findings.passage: Easy access to guns is a public health crisis! Our young people should not have this kind of access to firearms.
findings.note: OSPI statement after a Seattle high school student's death; date taken from the page's listed date.

findings.passage: For our families, I am pleading with you that if you have firearms in your home, lock them up safely!
findings.note: Same statement; urges safe storage of guns at home.
